name: TC-ECV-02: first product name navigates to truck PDP
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/ElectricCommercialVehicles.cy.js#Homepage - ElectricCommercialVehicles [ta] TC-ECV-02: first product name navigates to truck PDP
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-ECV-02
**Title:** First product name navigates to truck PDP
**Language:** ta

**Description:**
In Electric Commercial Vehicles, click the first visible truck product name (not the image) and confirm the user opens that truck’s product detail page.

**Expected Result:**
The browser URL matches the product’s truck PDP path for the selected language (for example /en/{brand}-truck/{model}).

**Steps:**
1. Open the Electric Commercial Vehicles section
2. Click the first visible product name link
3. Verify the URL is the matching truck PDP
